markets.rules_secondary:
If the India vs Sri Lanka men's professional Asian Games Men cricket match originally scheduled for Oct 1, 2026 at 12:30 AM EDT ends in a tie, draw, no result (NR), abandonment, or cancellation, and no official winner is declared, all markets will resolve to $0.50.

  If it occurs after the match has begun, and the governing body declares an official winner, the market will resolve based on that result.
